meta.name: health-data
meta.description: Query Apple Health SQLite database for vitals, activity, sleep, and workouts. Supports Markdown, JSON, and FHIR R4 output formats. This skill should be used when analyzing health metrics, generating health reports, answering questions about fitness or sleep patterns, or exporting health data in standard formats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并分析Apple健康数据，生成报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从Apple Health提取数据并分析或导出。
copy.tagline_en: Query and analyze Apple Health data to generate reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract, analyze, or export health data from Apple Health.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询你本地的 Apple Health 数据库（包含 6.3M+ 条记录、43 种指标），回答关于生命体征、活动、睡眠、锻炼的问题，并以 Markdown、JSON、FHIR R4 或 ASCII 格式输出结果。
howto.when: 当你要分析健康指标、生成健康报告、询问健身或睡眠模式，或导出健康数据为标准格式时，Claude 会触发本技能。

say.text: 查一下我昨天的心率平均值
say.note: 返回昨日心率的平均、最小、最大值。

say.text: 用 JSON 导出最近一周的步数
say.note: 输出 JSON 格式的每日步数。

say.text: 分析过去两周的睡眠质量
say.note: 返回每天睡眠时长和深睡/REM 时间。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can query your local Apple Health database (6.3M+ records, 43 metrics) and answer questions about vitals, activity, sleep, workouts, and output results in Markdown, JSON, FHIR R4, or ASCII format.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you ask to analyze health metrics, generate health reports, query fitness or sleep patterns, or export health data in standard formats.

say_en.text: Show me my average heart rate for yesterday.
say_en.note: Returns average, min, max heart rate for that day.

say_en.text: Export my step count for the last week as JSON.
say_en.note: Outputs daily step data in JSON format.

say_en.text: Analyze my sleep quality over the past two weeks.
say_en.note: Returns nightly duration, deep and REM sleep hours.
